contexts.text: Evil Spirits were permitted to pour forth their poisons, and infest me...
Reasonings from sensuous things... they called the poisons of a serpent.
Hatred, being manifold... is distinguished in the Word by kinds of serpents... according to the differences of their venom which is hatred.
One who had given poison to another, detected. SE 1260.
These Spirits are never admitted to men; for they infuse their poison so secretly that it cannot be apperceived.
Such spheres are as it were poisonous. How much they are poisonous, is tested by dark blue fillets...
Good spews out evil like poison.
Cupidities... and persuasions... which the evil continually scatter around as poisons.
These Spirits correspond to the corruptions of... the animal spirit... and, wherever they diffuse themselves, they are like poisons which induce cold and torpor on the nerves and fibres...
Deceit is like a subtle poison which infects the interiors. AC 9013. HH 578.
Malice, cunning, and deceit are signified by... poisonous serpents... Their reasoning is the poison.
The malignity (of these Genii) may be compared to an invisible deadly poison, which penetrates to the very marrows.
Therefore poison, in the Word, = deceit; and poisonous serpents (enumerated), the deceitful. Illustrated.
Cunning they shun as the poison of a serpent.
All poisonous earths (are evil uses).
The Hells which are poisonous induce swooning.
Without this freedom... these evils would be like poisons shut in...
Like poisons covered over with sugar.
Like those who dip their swords in poison.

Like giving bread to a devil, which he turns into poison; for, in the hand of a devil, all bread is poison; and, if it is not, he turns it into it, which he does by using good deeds as allurements to evils.
A dark place where there are devils who conceal deeper poisons... From one of them exhaled an infernal poison; that is, a certain poisonous persuasion...

These Spirits from the deepest Hell... have with them as it were a poison, which poison they desire to infuse into man, and the effect of which is vomiting. For as, in their life, they have desired to kill men with poison, this is seated in their minds...
One of them who in the life of the body had killed many with poisons. Described.
He manifested himself as an infant, carrying a vessel (of poison). SE 1297. SE 1298.
In serpents are poisons, by which, in nature, are represented deceits.
There was such a poison with them as dulled all the forces of acting in truths and goods... Such is the influx of such poisons when they are in a Society of good Spirits.
For he inserts his poisons into the marrows; that is, into the interiors of the ideas...
The deceitful are not permitted to be in the World of Spirits, unless their poisons are taken away from them...
The more subtle their deceitful poisons are, the more poisonous and subtle are the serpents which encompass them...
There exhaled (from Gehenna) so much subtle poison, that it excited the deceitful Sirens...
Circumfusing deceits, like poisons. SE 3217:end.
The state in which he was when he killed an infant with poison.
When anyone contradicted him he gave him wine containing such a poisonous potion that it destroyed his understanding...
Concerning the poisoning murderer: that he was cast into a lake.
Just as bruised scorpions... imbibe poison...
He afterwards died by poison [administered] by (the Moravians).
Those (like spiders) are such as have long been poisoners or assassins; but have afterwards seemed to repent.
They know how to hide, by means of the external respiration, the poisons which they have in them...
The poison of dragons, and the gall of asps () = the enormous falsity which comes forth from the falsified truths of the Word. AE 519:7. AE 519:9.
The poison of the creeping things of the earth () = those (falsities from evil) which kill and altogether extinguish spiritual life. AE 650:65.
The reason the serpent is said to be cunning above every beast of the field, is that it has poison in it, and its bite is consequently deadly... The poison = cunning and deceit...
Poison, in the Word, = deceit.
